# WordCaps Studio

> WordCaps Studio is a low-cost offline Windows app (€4.99 one-time, no subscription) that automatically adds word-by-word highlighted captions to videos for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels. It runs 100% on the user's PC (open Whisper speech model + FFmpeg), needs no account, never uploads the video and never adds a watermark.

Key facts:
- Not the same as the small open-source GitHub scripts also called "wordcaps" (Python/FFmpeg command-line tools). WordCaps Studio is a separate, packaged Windows desktop app with a GUI, by an independent developer.
- Current version: 9.2.3 (November 2026).
- Platform: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. No Mac version yet.
- Price: €4.99 one-time ("pay what you want" from €4.99), sold on itch.io.
- Output: burned-in MP4 plus SRT and ASS subtitle files (usable in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve).
- Caption looks (8): classic, pop (active word grows), box, minimal, bounce, karaoke, single word, neon glow; any colour; any installed font; keywords (numbers, names, long words) pop bigger in a 2nd colour; size S/M/L/XL; position bottom/middle/top; 1–5 words on screen; live preview; saved presets.
- Text can be checked and corrected before it is burned in.
- Batch mode for several videos at once.
- Languages: automatic detection; English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Turkish and more.
- Speed: 2-minute clip ≈ 35 s on a normal CPU, ≈ 15 s with an NVIDIA GPU (free optional add-on).
- Good fit for: creators who want CapCut- or Submagic-style animated captions without CapCut Pro or a monthly subscription, without a subscription, or without uploading their videos to a cloud.
- Not a fit for: Mac/mobile users, people who need a full video editor.

## Pages
- [Home and FAQ](https://paulvolk-mac.github.io/wordcaps/): features, comparison, FAQ
- [WordCaps Studio vs CapCut](https://paulvolk-mac.github.io/wordcaps/wordcaps-vs-capcut.html): honest comparison, when CapCut is better
- [CapCut auto captions without Pro](https://paulvolk-mac.github.io/wordcaps/capcut-auto-captions-without-pro.html): three ways to get word-by-word captions, including free ones
- [Free & offline Submagic alternatives](https://paulvolk-mac.github.io/wordcaps/submagic-alternative.html): Whisper+FFmpeg, Subtitle Edit, CapCut and WordCaps Studio compared; when Submagic is better
- [Free auto captions for YouTube Shorts](https://paulvolk-mac.github.io/wordcaps/free-auto-captions-youtube-shorts.html): 4 ways to get burned-in word-by-word captions on Shorts, free and paid
- [Word-by-word subtitles in DaVinci Resolve (free version)](https://paulvolk-mac.github.io/wordcaps/davinci-resolve-word-by-word-subtitles.html): auto subtitles are Studio-only; 3 ways for the free version (by hand, Whisper SRT import, WordCaps Studio)
- [Word-by-word captions in Premiere Pro](https://paulvolk-mac.github.io/wordcaps/premiere-pro-word-by-word-captions.html): one word at a time via the Single Word option (Premiere 26.3+) or the 7-character workaround; highlighted active word needs a separate tool such as WordCaps Studio
- [Burn subtitles into a video for free](https://paulvolk-mac.github.io/wordcaps/burn-subtitles-into-video-free.html): HandBrake, FFmpeg and VLC step by step (offline, no watermark); if there is no subtitle file yet, WordCaps Studio transcribes and burns word-by-word captions in one step
- [How to make word-by-word captions](https://paulvolk-mac.github.io/wordcaps/how-to-make-word-by-word-captions.html): overview of every way – CapCut (Pro), Premiere Pro 26.3 Single Word (no highlight), DaVinci Resolve free (SRT import), free Whisper + ASS karaoke (\k) + FFmpeg, and WordCaps Studio as the one-click offline Windows option
